For a 50-person Indian company, the purchase-ready shortlist is:

MakeMyTrip myBiz — lowest-friction starting point. It has corporate fares, policy controls, GST invoices, expense management and advertised free date-change/cancellation on qualifying special fares. Its contract makes clear that airline/hotel rules still govern refunds, and its service fee is negotiated; a 1.5% payment-gateway fee can apply to wallet/card funding. 
MakeMyTrip Business
+1

Verify: per-booking fee, 1.5% applicability, refund SLA, after-hours support and unused-ticket handling.

FCM Travel India — fuller managed service. It offers negotiated corporate rates, 420+ airline partners, dedicated consultants and 24/7 support. Hotel programme savings are advertised at up to 38%, but supplier cancellation charges can reach 100%, and refunds may take 12+ weeks. 
FCM Travel
+1

Verify: transaction fees, implementation fee, SLA, cancellation/reissue schedule and exit terms.

Trip.Biz — technology-heavy alternative. Its newly launched Agent ONE targets automated corporate booking and oversight. 
PR Newswire

Verify: India-specific inventory, service fees, human-support coverage and refund/reissue SLA.

Before paying: require a written 12-month all-in quote in INR, including booking/reissue/cancellation fees, GST, payment charges, implementation, support, and contract termination. Public sources don't disclose comparable fixed totals, so don't accept a headline “saving” as the price.
